Yes, we absolutely do! We have the Soylent Rewards program designed to thank our loyal customers. It's pretty straightforward:

Shop and Engage: Simply shop with Soylent and engage with our community.
Earn Credits: You'll earn credits for your activities.
Get Rewarded: Use those credits to apply to future orders!
How to Earn Credits:
Refer a friend: You can earn a $15 credit when you refer a friend. Plus, your friend gets a $15 discount, and we donate 10 meals to our food bank partners!
Eligible Purchases: You'll earn 3% in credits on your eligible purchases.
How to Use Your Credits:

You can use your earned credits to pay for upcoming subscription orders or one-time purchases. If you're a subscriber, you can toggle on the option to auto-apply your credits to your next order on the "View your next order" page. For one-time orders, you can apply them directly on the checkout page.

Checking Your Balance:

You can check your available credits and credit activity by logging into your account, clicking "Manage subscriptions" (even if you're not a subscriber), then "Address & payment details," and finally "Manage payment methods."

Important Notes:
Credits will expire 12 months after they are earned.
Rewarded promotions or codes cannot be combined (limit 1 promo per transaction).
Accruals and balances can take up to 14 days for approval or refresh.

You can learn more about the Soylent Rewards program and its full details here.
